duas.title: Seeking Cure from Illness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adh-hibil-ba's, ishfi antash-Shafi la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm, cure (him/her), for You are the Healer. There is no cure except Your cure – a cure which leaves no illness behind.

duas.title: Good Health and Protection
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me good hearing. O Allah, grant me good eyesight.

duas.title: Visiting the Sick
duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.translation: I ask Allah the Almighty, the Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you. (Recite 7 times)

duas.title: Pain Relief
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi a'udhu bi'izzatillahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I seek refuge in Allah's might and power from the evil of what I feel and fear.
